policy.causal_rule: A successful CI run validates a code branch, not market predictability. Company-wide stablecoin metrics, dashboard positioning and ETF-flow tracker values do not establish XRP price causality without reconciled measurements and out-of-sample evidence.

edges.claim: PR #1343 preserves the legacy 1659/772/46.5% values for audit while marking predictive skill NOT_EVALUATED because the prior method used variable horizons, later live prices and mutable history.
Main evaluator requests a later live price after a minimum age, uses variable elapsed horizons, and rewrites signal_history.jsonl. Its percentage is not a fixed-horizon out-of-sample score.
Branch metadata reports protected=true but an empty required-check list; effective rulesets and bypass behavior remain unknown.
Coinbase's Q2 report states $20B average USDC held in Coinbase products and 10.3% crypto trading-volume market share; these are company-wide figures and do not quantify XRP-specific flow.
The official notice scheduled Q3 results for Oct 29 after market close; this capture did not establish the contents or publication of a Q3 release.
Alpha Finance reports zero USD flow for Oct 28 while the earlier XRP Insights snapshot reports a provisional positive XRP-denominated flow; fund universe, units and settlement differ.
Secondary dashboards range from about $1.44B to $3.02B OI at different times and scopes; no value is admitted as a model feature.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Most of the $1.44B, $2.03B and $3.02B XRP open-interest spread reflects differing timestamps, venue coverage, instrument populations or aggregation methods rather than one synchronized market state.
disconfirming_evidence: No synchronized per-venue contract-level panel has been reconstructed.
The vendor dashboards may overlap in venues; the exact contribution of scope differences is unknown.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Positive funding and long-skewed account ratios alongside long-heavy liquidations may indicate fragile leveraged-long positioning in XRP perpetuals.
disconfirming_evidence: Account ratios are not notional exposure.
Open interest and funding snapshots are not synchronized with spot order books or ETF flows.
A different dashboard population reports a lower long/short ratio in an older snapshot.

competing_hypotheses.claim: The Oct 28 ETF-flow disagreement is primarily caused by unit, fund-universe, settlement or data-completeness differences rather than opposite estimates of the same quantity.
disconfirming_evidence: No issuer-level holdings and shares-outstanding reconstruction was completed in this run.
The provisional XRP-denominated observation may be revised.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Coinbase's reported USDC economics and diversified revenue mix may reduce its company-wide dependence on spot trading, but do not establish an XRP-specific flow or price channel.
disconfirming_evidence: Q3 release content was not verified at capture.
No XRP-specific Coinbase volume, inventory, collateral usage or route-level flows were measured.
